description: Stop Claude Code from asking whether to trust your home folder every time a window opens.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: This extension records folders as trusted for Claude Code, so it stays off in Restricted Mode.

config.title: Trust Home Folder for Claude Code
config.enabled: Record folders as trusted for Claude Code, so its "Trust this folder in Claude Code?" dialog does not appear. Off by default: nothing is changed until you turn this on.
config.scope: Which folders to record as trusted while the extension is on.
config.scope.homeFolder.label: Home folder only
config.scope.openedFolders.label: Home folder and every opened folder
config.scope.homeFolder: Only your home folder. Claude Code never remembers its answer for this folder, so it asks in every new window.
config.scope.openedFolders: Your home folder and every folder opened in a window. **Use with care:** a folder's `.claude/settings.json` and `.mcp.json` can run programs on your computer, and they will be used without asking. A folder inside a Git repository trusts the whole repository.
